description: Curate the life you want to live. #selflove #leadershipskills #selfmastery
transcript: I remain regulated because I know that every experience that I'm having is for me. More that I've explored life from a lens of no judgment, exploration. If I'm doing something, it's because I love it. If I'm in a space, it's because I'm giving value to that space. I don't force myself to live in any world where I don't belong. Not everything is for me, and that's okay. But the things that are for me are filled with clouds and butterflies and flowers and they smell amazing.
